notes: Numeric lookup in NFM A6.7 table 6.7-6 (reporting resolution by turbidity range and method). Claims: tby-t6-low-rows-01 (0 to <1 reported to nearest 0.05 under USGS, ASTM, EPA 180.1 and GLI Method 2, nearest 0.01 under ISO 7027; 1 to <10 nearest 0.1 under all five), tby-t6-40-100-row-01 (40 to <100: nearest 1 under USGS/ASTM, nearest 5 under EPA 180.1 and GLI, ISO 7027 not applicable), tby-usgs-conforms-astm-01 (USGS follows ASTM unless the data are for drinking-water compliance under EPA 180.1, GLI Method 2 or ISO 7027). Table 6.7-6 is complete with caption and column header inside chunk 46 — the headerless repeat at the top of chunk 47 is not used. A6.7 is the corpus's only turbidity source; there is no turbidity probe datasheet in the slice, so expected to favor rag is near-certain here.

turns.content: The turbidity meter showed 0.42 at one site and 63.7 at another. How many decimal places do we actually keep when we log those?

must_contain: States 0.42 is logged to the nearest 0.05 unit under the USGS convention
States 63.7 is logged to the nearest 1 unit under the USGS convention
Attributes the resolutions to a USGS reporting-guidelines table (NFM A6.7 table 6.7-6 or NFM A6.8 table 6.8-7)
must_not: Invents a reporting resolution not in the table
Applies one blanket number of decimal places across all turbidity ranges
Rounds 0.42 to a whole number or keeps 63.7 to two decimals

turns.content: One of those sites feeds a drinking-water intake and that data goes out under EPA Method 180.1. Does the same rounding apply there?

must_contain: States EPA Method 180.1 also uses the nearest 0.05 unit below 1 turbidity unit, the same as USGS
States EPA Method 180.1 rounds to the nearest 5 units in the 40 to under 100 range, coarser than the USGS nearest 1
Notes USGS follows ASTM guidelines unless the data were collected for drinking-water compliance under EPA 180.1, GLI Method 2, or ISO 7027
must_not: Claims the EPA and USGS resolutions are identical across every range
Gives an ISO 7027 value for the 40 to 100 range, which the table marks not applicable
Invents an EPA resolution not in the table
